sample_data.reset_instructions: The published fixture ships in the repository at P08_school_results_public.json and is used unmodified. To restore the initial data at any time, run `npm run migrate:supabase` or visit `/dashboard/seed-data` and click 'Reset & Recalculate Seed Dataset'. It clears every class and student evaluation table and reloads case PUB-01 (60 students across Class 9 and Class 10, 540 subject mark entries, 41 checking list flags), then re-runs the deterministic GPA calculation engine. It is safe to re-run; nothing outside the school database is touched. Judges who only want to look around need not reset anything — editing marks in live mode updates in-memory and Supabase records in real time, and `npm run migrate:supabase` reverses it.

problem_solving_method: The core is a pure, deterministic calculation engine using arbitrary-precision arithmetic (Decimal.js) that treats every student's evaluation against the exact national curriculum rules: the 6 compulsory subjects (BAN, ENG, MAT, REL, PHY, CHE) are evaluated over a strict 6.0 GPA divisor, while the single chosen elective (BIO, HMT, or AGR) adds bonus points max(0, GP_optional - 2.0) without altering the divisor. Practical subjects (PHY, CHE, BIO, HMT, AGR) enforce independent dual-component pass thresholds (Theory >= 25/75 AND Practical >= 8/25), where failing either component results in Subject GP 0.00 (Grade F). Any compulsory failure overrides the student's final GPA to 0.00 (Grade F), while the uncancelled raw GPA is preserved in the explainable audit trace. Keeping the engine pure — no React, no database imports — is what lets `npm test` exercise the real logic against all 26 unit tests and 8 mandatory benchmark edge cases with 0 floating-point drift. Everything above it (Rule R-29 pre-publication checking lists, CSV/TSV/JSON marks ingestion with row-by-row rejection diagnostics, class failure analytics, and printable transcripts) is a further pure function over the student records.

R1.evidence: src/engine/rules.ts & src/engine/calculator.ts — Dual-component pass constraint (Theory >= 25/75 and Practical >= 8/25) for PHY, CHE, BIO, HMT, AGR. Evaluated independently; failing either component yields Subject GP 0.00 (F). Visible on /dashboard/results and in per-student audit traces.

R2.evidence: src/engine/rules.ts:calculateOptionalBonus — Optional 4th subject bonus points max(0, GP_optional - 2.0) over 6 compulsory subjects with strict 6.0 divisor. Proved by test cases EDGE-04 (GP 2.0 -> 0.0 bonus) and EDGE-05 (GP 5.0 -> +3.0 bonus). Visible on /dashboard/results and /dashboard/marks-entry.

R3.evidence: src/engine/calculator.ts:calculateStudentGPA — Compulsory fail override (any compulsory subject with GP 0.00 overrides Final GPA to 0.00 and Letter Grade to F). Raw uncapped GPA is retained and displayed in the audit trace; GPA is capped at 5.00 (A+). Proved by EDGE-01, EDGE-02, EDGE-03, EDGE-06, EDGE-07.

R4.evidence: src/engine/rules.ts:classifyCheckingFlags & src/app/dashboard/checking-lists/page.tsx — Rule R-29 Pre-Publication Checking Lists: Optional List (GP <= 2.0 or AB), Practical Fail List (Practical < 8), and Absent List (AB in any subject). Supports multi-list membership and teacher verification sign-off tracking.

team_members.major_contribution: Sole author of full-stack architecture, deterministic GPA calculation engine (Decimal.js), 26 unit tests covering all 8 benchmark edge cases, R-29 pre-publication checking lists, marks sheet ingestion with row rejection diagnostics, class failure analytics, and Supabase integration.

major_design_decisions: Used Decimal.js for all arithmetic operations to eliminate IEEE-754 floating-point rounding errors in grade point summations and division by 6.0.
The calculation engine is pure TypeScript — no React, no database imports — which allows `npm test` to execute all 26 test cases in under 1 second without a database or server running.
Preserved the 'AB' absence token throughout the engine and data tables without converting to numeric 0, accurately distinguishing unattempted exams from zero scores.
The 6 compulsory subjects (BAN, ENG, MAT, REL, PHY, CHE) are strictly separated from the 3 electives (BIO, HMT, AGR) in both data structures and UI tables with purple-tinted elective headers.
Integrated row-by-row marks sheet validator at /dashboard/import supporting CSV, TSV, and JSON with exact rule rejection diagnostics and suggested fixes before committing to the database.
Built a root-cause subject failure classifier at /dashboard/analytics identifying the single worst-performing subject with breakdowns for Theory (<25), Practical (<8), and Absences.
Hybrid in-memory singleton cache with Supabase PostgreSQL synchronization ensures zero cold starts and instant recalculation across dev and production environments.
known_limitations: Currently supports single-session examinations (Annual / Term Final). Multi-term cumulative weighted progression (Half-Yearly 30% + Final 70%) is architected and scheduled for the next release roadmap.
Teacher sign-off records the auditor's name, timestamp, and notes in the database; hardware biometric PKI signature card integration is not implemented.
Demo login credentials (admin@school.edu / admin123) are published on the sign-in page at /login so judges can immediately access the portal without credential setup.

ai_tools_used.used_for: Dataset analysis, calculation engine modeling, test-driven validation, UI dashboard design, and rule compliance verification.
ai_tools_used.how_output_was_verified: Nothing was accepted on the model's word. The published dataset and grading rules were probed before writing code. `npm test` runs 26 unit tests asserting all 8 mandatory benchmark edge cases. Calculations were verified against manual arithmetic traces across all 60 students.
